pattern: Do not state an unverified claim as a fact.
criterion: Do not state an unverified claim as a fact.

lesson.title: Verify Product History Before Assuming Specific Items
lesson.when: a customer refers to a item discussed in a previous interaction without naming the specific item or SKU
lesson.do: ask the customer to confirm the exact product name or lookup the recorded interaction history before asserting a specific item
lesson.otherwise: express uncertainty about which item was previously discussed instead of assuming a specific product or SKU
triggers: gọi tiếp về món đã hỏi
người nhà đã đồng ý món đã hỏi
customer calling back about previous item
